summary: Misplaced hikers lost on a trail in Blodgett Peak Open Space on a Sunday evening; Colorado Springs Fire Department high-angle team (Engine 18) located them and assisted them out; no injuries.
location: Blodgett Peak Open Space, northwest Colorado Springs area
notes: Date Sunday-verified (incident reported Sunday evening per KKTV story; CSFD PIO tweet dated 2022-09-26). Victim count: plural hikers, exact number unconfirmed — recorded as 2 per the vague-plural convention. Not the parked ~2022-06-20 Blodgett high-angle lead (that one stays parked).
